description_en: Updates the rate limiting bandwidth for a cloud application service instance. You can call the DescribeRenderingInstance operation to retrieve the current rate limiting value and check the status of the rate limiting update
description_zh:
更新一个云应用服务实例的限速带宽。
可以通过实例查询接口DescribeRenderingInstance，获取限速值与限速更新状态
name: ModifyRenderingInstanceBandwidth

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud application service instance
parameters.name: rendering_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum inbound bandwidth for rate limiting. Unit: Mbit/s. You must specify at least one of MaxIngressBandwidth and MaxEgressBandwidth.

By default, no rate limit is configured for the instance.

If you do not specify this parameter or set it to 0, the last configuration is retained.

If you set this parameter to a value less than 0, the rate limit is reset to unlimited
parameters.help_zh:
入方向最大限流，单位Mb/s。MaxIngressBandwidth/MaxEgressBandwidth至少必选其一，
实例原始配置不限流；
无输入或输入0时，默认保留最后一次配置
输入小于0时，重置为不限流
parameters.name: max_ingress_bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The maximum outbound bandwidth for rate limiting. Unit: Mbit/s. You must specify at least one of MaxIngressBandwidth and MaxEgressBandwidth.

By default, no rate limit is configured for the instance.

If you do not specify this parameter or set it to 0, the last configuration is retained.

If you set this parameter to a value less than 0, the rate limit is reset to unlimited
parameters.help_zh:
出方向最大限流，单位Mb/s。MaxIngressBandwidth/MaxEgressBandwidth至少必选其一，
实例原始配置不限流；
无输入或输入0时，默认保留最后一次配置
输入小于0时，重置为不限流
parameters.name: max_egress_bandwidth
